_comment: CheXpert Plus. Only the required keys and expected_stats are written here. The other config fields are not written yet.

expected_stats._comment: Checked by tests/test_dataset_stats.py, with the default drop_uncertain=True. Sources: df_chexpert_plus_240401.csv (223,462 images: train 223,228, valid 234) and the label file impression_fixed.json (one line per image, D-48), read with pandas. A blank label is 0, and an image with any -1 label is dropped. A row with every label blank has no label at all, so it gets NaN in every label (D-05, V-H1-41). uncertain counts these rows, from the raw label file read with pandas. No patient is in both splits. sex and age_years come from the CSV columns sex and age (years). The sex Unknown (203 train rows and 1 valid row, after the drop of uncertain rows) gives NaN (D-26).
